target_profile.system_boundary: Captured go.etcd.io/raft/v3 library implements replicated-log state machines and in-memory storage. Network transport, durable disk writes and user state-machine application are caller-owned; Node and RawNode adapters are in scope.
protocol_contexts: Local raft instance, term, log prefix and simple/joint configuration
ownership: Node serializes work in run; RawNode requires caller serialization.

activities.purpose: Qualified support for decision formation and legal advancement
activities.realization_summary: stepLeader, handleAppendEntries, raftLog owns Proposal, append response, heartbeat response, retry or matching follower append. stepLeader, releasePendingReadIndexMessages, readOnly owns ReadIndex and heartbeat acknowledgments.

activities.purpose: Context validity and acquisition, transfer or loss of authority
activities.realization_summary: raft.Step, campaign, stepCandidate, reset owns Tick/Hup or transfer TimeoutNow; vote requests/responses or higher-term traffic.

activities.purpose: Recovery and resynchronization of eligible participation
activities.realization_summary: newRaft, raft.restore, Bootstrap owns Initialization from Storage or received snapshot.
ApplyConfChange, Changer, switchToConfig owns Caller applies configuration entry; restore installs membership.
RawNode Ready and raft.appliedTo owns Ready emission and Advance or MsgStorageApplyResp; snapshot completion.

activities.purpose: History, persistence and reconstruction of support
activities.realization_summary: RawNode Ready/acceptReady/Advance, raft.send, raft.Step, unstable owns Ready acceptance, storage response or Advance.

activities.purpose: Client contracts, invocation intervals and observed completion
activities.realization_summary: node.run and external application owns API calls, incoming messages, Ready consumption, ticks and Stop.

behaviors.protocol_context: One local raft instance, term and active voter configuration
behaviors.trigger: Tick/Hup or transfer TimeoutNow; vote requests/responses or higher-term traffic
implementation_guards: Campaign requires local voting eligibility, no pending snapshot and no committed unapplied configuration change.
Vote grants require eligible term/vote state and candidate log freshness; pre-vote does not update term.
Election result uses both voter majorities in joint configuration.
writes: Term and Vote on candidacy or higher-term transition; role, leader, timers and per-peer progress on reset.
Reset clears vote tally, readOnly quorum queue and transfer state; retains log and committed decisions.
external_effects: Winning election appends current-term empty entry and broadcasts replication.
CheckQuorum loss steps down; transfer waits for transferee catch-up, rejects proposals while active and times out after electionTimeout ticks.
async_boundaries: Self vote and remote vote responses pass through msgsAfterAppend before counting.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Role and term determine which replication responses count; new leader commits a current-term entry before releasing ordinary queued reads.

unknowns: pendingReadIndexMessages is separate from readOnly and is not cleared in reset; investigate subsequent use across role changes.

behaviors.protocol_context: Leader term and current joint/simple voter configuration
behaviors.trigger: Proposal, append response, heartbeat response, retry or matching follower append
implementation_guards: Leader rejects proposals during transfer or after removal and enforces pending configuration change checks.
Follower checks previous entry identity and forbids overwriting committed entries.
Leader commitment requires quorum match index with local log term equal to current term.
writes: Proposal entries receive index and current term; successful acknowledgments raise peer Match.
Commit advances monotonically; append rejection backs off Next and retries.
external_effects: Append-response commitment calls releasePendingReadIndexMessages then bcastAppend.
Heartbeat response resumes flow and can certify safe reads; periodic heartbeat carries min(peer Match, committed).
async_boundaries: Successful append responses, including leader self acknowledgment, wait for caller persistence.

cross_activity_effects.A2: A committed current-term entry supplies a prerequisite for deferred read processing.

behaviors.protocol_context: Caller-owned durable storage with sync or async completion
behaviors.trigger: Ready acceptance, storage response or Advance
legal_preconditions: Caller obeys Ready persistence and message ordering; async local targets are reliable and ordered independently.
writes: Accepted entries marked in progress; acknowledged entry identity retires matching unstable prefix.
durable_effects: Library exposes work; actual persistence is performed by caller.
important_branches: Old-term append acknowledgments do not stabilize entries; snapshot completions remain valid.
HardState-only append work includes last entry identity when unstable entries remain, replacing old-term acknowledgments.
Synchronous self responses are held until Advance; asynchronous responses are attached to local append messages.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Durability-before-response prevents counting support that disappears on restart.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Term/vote persistence constrains elections and old completion eligibility.

behaviors.protocol_context: Committed configuration application or restored ConfState
behaviors.trigger: Caller applies configuration entry; restore installs membership
implementation_guards: Simple changes alter at most one voter; joint changes require both old and new majorities; cannot remove all voters.
Demotions retain outgoing voter status until joint exit.
writes: Voters, learners and progress tracker updated; AutoLeave records implicit exit intent.
important_branches: Leader switchToConfig may advance commitment and broadcast; this branch does not call releasePendingReadIndexMessages.
Removed/demoted leader optionally steps down and returns before normal leader follow-up; removed transferee otherwise cancels transfer.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Reinterprets existing peer matches under changed quorum and may advance committed index.

unknowns: Can configuration-triggered first current-term commitment legally leave pending reads without a release trigger?

behaviors.protocol_context: Committed prefix, applying and applied indexes
behaviors.trigger: Ready emission and Advance or MsgStorageApplyResp; snapshot completion
writes: acceptApplying records dispatched index and size; completion raises applied and releases byte pressure.
important_branches: Async application is bounded by stable local entries; pending snapshots block entry dispatch.
appliedTo in leader AutoLeave state attempts empty configuration proposal when applied >= pendingConfIndex; transfer can reject it.
async_boundaries: Application is external; Ready batches must be applied in order. Advance may precede actual application under documented sync optimization.

cross_activity_effects.A4: Applied progress can initiate automatic joint exit.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Applied configuration position determines campaign eligibility.

unknowns: After automatic exit is dropped during transfer, what guarantees another appliedTo call if transfer times out without new proposals?

behaviors.trigger: Initialization from Storage or received snapshot
writes: Initialization restores ConfState, HardState term/vote/commit and caller Applied index.
Snapshot either fast-forwards matching log commitment or replaces log and configuration; obsolete snapshot rejected.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Reconstructs the committed prefix and catches followers up after compaction.
cross_activity_effects.A2: Pending snapshot blocks promotion; restored configuration determines eligibility.

behaviors.protocol_context: ReadOnlySafe or lease-based reads under leader context
writes: Non-singleton requests before first current-term commitment enter pendingReadIndexMessages.
Safe requests record committed index and context, self-ack and await joint-quorum heartbeat acknowledgment.
external_effects: Quorum acknowledgment releases queued contexts up to the matching one to ReadState or forwarded response.
Singleton returns committed index immediately; lease-based mode responds after current-term gate without heartbeat quorum.
async_boundaries: Caller correlates RequestCtx and applies through returned index before reading state machine.

cross_activity_effects.A7: Returns an index/context witness rather than completing a client state-machine read.

unknowns: Configuration-triggered commitment differs from append-response commitment in its deferred-read follow-up.

behaviors.protocol_context: Serialized node API or caller-serialized RawNode
behaviors.trigger: API calls, incoming messages, Ready consumption, ticks and Stop
legal_preconditions: Caller retries proposals; an accepted proposal need not commit.
Caller applies configuration changes from committed entries and records ConfState in snapshots.
external_effects: node.run serializes state-machine work; Ready acceptance gates next sync batch until Advance.
Stop closes done; RawNode has no background worker.

cross_activity_effects.A1: Delivers proposals and support messages without promising proposal completion.
cross_activity_effects.A5: Caller owns persistence/application and batch ordering.

facts.meaning: Local raftLog.committed is the highest prefix index this instance currently treats as committed; this alone does not say that the prefix has been locally applied or that read requests have been released.
facts.validity_context: The installed log and configuration history. Leader advancement uses current-term quorum support; followers import bounded leader commitment; restart/snapshot reconstruct prior decisions.
facts.durability: Included in HardState; entry and vote durability follows caller contract. Commit-only HardState updates need not force fsync.
facts.recovery: Restored from Storage HardState and snapshot position, with range checks.

facts.meaning: The local tracker configuration identifies incoming/outgoing voters, learners and whether joint exit is automatic.
facts.validity_context: Locally applied configuration history or restored snapshot; another member may be at a different applied position.
facts.durability: Caller records ConfState in snapshots and retains configuration log entries.
facts.recovery: confchange.Restore through newRaft or snapshot installation.

surfaces.reason: Can a legal delayed configuration application first commit the current term without releasing queued reads, and do other triggers repair that difference?
Automatic exit can be rejected during transfer; timeout clears transfer but does not itself retry exit. Determine responsibility and whether legal quiescent histories need another caller operation.

formation.explanation: A leader admits proposals subject to membership, transfer and configuration guards, assigns term/index and replicates. Followers validate previous log identity and preserve committed prefixes. Append responses and self support wait for persistence. Current-term leader consumes tracked voter matches via majority or both joint majorities; a matching current-term quorum endpoint advances commitment. Append/heartbeat propagate commitment, and Ready dispatches bounded committed prefixes to caller application. Heartbeat responses also restore replication flow after losses; compaction can require snapshot catch-up.

context.explanation: Eligible followers campaign after logical timeout or explicit request, with unapplied committed configuration and pending-snapshot guards. Vote freshness and term/vote rules constrain support; persisted self and remote votes feed current voter quorums. Pre-vote probes without term change. Winning installs leader state and an empty current-term entry. Higher terms, same-term leader traffic to candidates and optional quorum loss change role; reset clears progress, vote tally, read quorum state and transfer while preserving log decisions. Transfer catches up a voter then requests election; proposals pause and timeout aborts transfer. Lower-term network work is rejected or answered with current term; old storage acknowledgments have separate entry/snapshot handling.

connection.explanation: Authority selects whose support can form decisions, but committed history survives authority changes. Log freshness carries prior decisions into elections; current-term commitment qualifies deferred read processing. Configuration application changes both quorum aggregation and election eligibility, and can itself advance commitment using retained matches. Recovery reinstalls history and eligibility. Storage responses are term-filtered for overwrite-sensitive entries, whereas committed snapshot/application progress survives term transitions. Read quorum contexts reset on role change; the separate pre-first-commit request queue requires further lifecycle investigation.

open_details: Automatic joint-exit continuation after failed transfer.
Lease-read assumptions and deeper membership/recovery overlap variants remain open.
core_overview.rationale: Representative formation, authority transition, storage completion, configuration, recovery and application paths have been read. Local continuation anomalies remain open and no defect is presumed.
